key_fiscal_facts.value_text: 30-40% cost oil cap (standard Western Desert); 60-80% for frontier/deepwater/Nile Delta single-point; 25-35% mature brownfield. EGPC model PSC: 40% standard.

40.55% effective income tax on petroleum profit: 22.5% base CIT (Income Tax Law No 91/2005 as amended) + petroleum-specific surtax. Key: EGPC pays this tax on behalf of IOC contractor (tax-paid PSC). IOC receives profit oil before tax; EGPC bears obligation.
10% (standard Western Desert); 5-10% deepwater/frontier; some concessions exempt

EGPC mandatory participating interest in all PSCs. Typically 25-50% WI. Most PSCs: EGPC 50% PI (paying). Specific blocks negotiated lower (25-40%). EGPC also receives government share of profit oil separately.
